A job in the early morning, so you have plenty of time left for your hobbies in the rest of the afternoon! Or for groceries, perhaps 😉. As a warehouse employee at PostNL in Westzaan, your shift starts at 05:00! So, it's for the real early birds. Additionally, PostNL Westzaan is a real #baanrader. They score an 8+ for job satisfaction! Want to know more? Read this vacancy quickly.

What we offer
- Salary of €14,99 gross per hour!
- Working before 06:00? Get an extra 30%!
- 40% Saturday bonus: €20,98 per hour!
- Travel allowance from 6 km!
- Weekly payments!
- Afternoons and evenings are free!

Who you are
As a warehouse employee, you're active in the early morning! You never get out of bed on the wrong side. We don't ask for much, but we do require the following:

- You are at least 3 days available per week
- You are available from Monday to Saturday
- You are available from 05:00 - 13:00
- You are available for work for at least 3 months
- You speak Dutch or English
- You have your own transportation to get to PostNL in Westzaan
- You are able to perform a lot of physical work with packages

What will you do
You will ensure that the packages get to the delivery vans! As a warehouse employee, you're constantly on the move. In the morning, trucks full of packages arrive. The trucks must first be unloaded, and then the roll containers need to be brought to the correct location. After that, a team is ready to place all the packages on the conveyor belt. This is also called 'feeding'. Sounds simple, but don't be mistaken: some packages can weigh up to 23 kilos! Then the packages are sorted via a conveyor belt, and the deliverers can load their own vans. On to the customers!

Where will you work
You will work at the PostNL depot in Westzaan! The depot is located on a business park in the Westzaner-Overtoom. It's a small and close-knit team that enjoys helping each other. You'll also work with many nationalities, which means a lot of English is spoken. Do you have no e
